title: Music
statementMd:
Little Lesha loves listening to music via his smartphone. But the smartphone doesn't have much memory, so Lesha listens to his favorite songs in a well-known social network InTalk.

Unfortunately, internet is not that fast in the city of Ekaterinozavodsk and the song takes a lot of time to download. But Lesha is quite impatient. The song's duration is $*T*$ seconds. Lesha downloads the first $*S*$ seconds of the song and plays it. When the playback reaches the point that has not yet been downloaded, Lesha immediately plays the song from the start (the loaded part of the song stays in his phone, and the download is continued from the same place), and it happens until the song is downloaded completely and Lesha listens to it to the end. For $*q*$ seconds of real time the Internet allows you to download $*q* - 1$ seconds of the track.

Tell Lesha, for how many times he will start the song, including the very first start.

## Input

The single line contains three integers $*T*, *S*, *q*$ ($2 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{4}$, $1 ≤ *S* < *T* ≤ 10^{5}$).

## Output

Print a single integer — the number of times the song will be restarted.

## Note

In the first test, the song is played twice faster than it is downloaded, which means that during four first seconds Lesha reaches the moment that has not been downloaded, and starts the song again. After another two seconds, the song is downloaded completely, and thus, Lesha starts the song twice.

In the second test, the song is almost downloaded, and Lesha will start it only once.

In the third sample test the download finishes and Lesha finishes listening at the same moment. Note that song isn't restarted in this case.
statementZhMd:
小 Lesha 喜欢通过智能手机听音乐。但是智能手机的存储空间不大，因此 Lesha 会在知名社交网络 InTalk 上听自己喜欢的歌曲。

不幸的是，叶卡捷琳诺扎沃茨克市的网速并不快，歌曲需要很长时间才能下载完成。但 Lesha 十分 impatient。歌曲时长为 $*T*$ 秒。Lesha 下载歌曲最开始的 $*S*$ 秒并开始播放。当播放到尚未下载的位置时，Lesha 会立即从头开始播放歌曲（歌曲已经加载的部分会保留在手机中，下载会从中断的位置继续），这一过程会持续到歌曲完全下载完毕，并且 Lesha 从头听到歌曲结尾。互联网每经过 $*q*$ 秒的实际时间，允许下载歌曲的 $*q* - 1*$ 秒。

请告诉 Lesha，他总共会开始播放歌曲多少次，包括第一次开始播放。

## 输入格式

一行包含三个整数 $*T*, *S*, *q*$（$2 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{4}$，$1 ≤ *S* < *T* ≤ 10^{5}$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——歌曲重新开始播放的次数。

## 说明

在第一个测试中，歌曲的播放速度是下载速度的两倍，这意味着在最初的四秒内，Lesha 就会播放到尚未下载的位置，并再次开始播放歌曲。再经过两秒，歌曲便会完全下载，因此 Lesha 总共开始播放歌曲两次。

在第二个测试中，歌曲几乎已经下载完毕，Lesha 只会开始播放一次。

在第三个样例中，下载完成与 Lesha 听完歌曲恰好发生在同一时刻。注意，在这种情况下歌曲不会重新开始播放。
